title: Patch: no practice HUD over the board; the enemy hero sits at the top
thread:
**Issue #2878 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2878: Patch: no practice HUD over the board; the enemy hero sits at the top
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

In a practice game the strip above the board, the practice HUD (`practice-hud` in `apps/web/src/routes/practice.tsx`, styled in `apps/web/src/practice/practice.css`), takes the top of the screen with things that are not the game, and leaves a gap between the screen's top and the enemy hero. **Rule for this issue: nothing that is not gameplay is drawn above the board during a game.**

**Measured on `main` (a practice game at its mulligan):**

| | Desktop 1280x720 | Phone 390x844 |
|---|---|---|
| The HUD shows | `PRACTICE · Easy · You go first · New game · Menu` | `Easy · New game · Menu` |
| HUD | 58px tall, its top 18px down | 56px tall, its top 12px down |
| Under it | — | `.game > .turn-banner` ("MULLIGAN"), 22px plus a 6px gap |
| Screen top → `hero-opponent` top | **94px** | **107px** |

Below the HUD there are three small gaps before the enemy hero: the shell's gap to the board (4–6px), `.board`'s top padding (8px desktop, 6px phone) and `.seat`'s top padding and border (6px, 5px phone).

**Seen on a phone at game over (the owner's screenshot, iPhone Safari on the deployed site, a practice loss):** it's worse there.
- The HUD reads `Easy · DEFEAT · New game · Menu`.
- Under it, R2379000's notice runs to two lines ("This game won't earn anything: This game's cards are from a version the server cannot check; reload the page.").
- Then an empty band of roughly 35 CSS px sits before the opponent's seat. Its source is not identified yet: the `.turn-banner` slot, or height the board leaves over at the top. The builder finds it.
- The outcome shows **twice**: `DEFEAT` in the HUD (`practice-outcome`) and the board's own result chip at the foot (`result-overlay` with `data-form="chip"`, `game/Result.tsx`, styled in `game/animations.css`: `LOSS` plus R434's `Their hand`).
- That chip is `position: fixed` at the screen's foot and lies over the control bar, covering End turn (it reads "Enemy t…") and crowding the `⋯` menu.

**Where each item goes**

| Now in the HUD (or above the board) | Gameplay? | Goes to |
|---|---|---|
| "Practice", the tier crest and the difficulty ("Easy") | No: it says who you're playing | The enemy hero's seat label: `AI · Easy` in place of `OPPONENT` (`hero-seat` in `game/Hero.tsx`), through a prop practice passes. A Sandbox game says `AI · Sandbox` or similar. The crest may come along if it fits. |
| "You go first" / "You go second" | Only before turn 1 | Off the board. If kept, it goes on the mulligan prompt, the only time it matters. |
| New game, Menu | No: they're controls for the screen | The control bar, beside Concede: on desktop and tablet as buttons, on the phone layouts (`PHONE_BAR_QUERY`) inside the `⋯` match menu (`game/MatchMenu.tsx`), where #2645 already put Offer draw and Concede. Keep their test ids (`practice-new-game`, `practice-menu`) and their "Leave this game?" confirmation. Once the game is over, New game may also sit on the result chip, as a one-tap rematch. |
| The game modifiers chip (`ModifierList`) | Yes | The control bar, through `Game`'s `matchStatus` prop, as `routes/match.tsx` already does |
| "AI is thinking…" (`ThinkIndicator`, `practice-thinking`) | Yes, already shown elsewhere | The control bar's turn box (`.turn-plate`) says it in place of "Opponent's turn" while the AI thinks, or it rides in `matchStatus`. The enemy hero's ring (`.practice-table[data-thinking="true"] .hero-opponent`) stays. The HUD's scan-line `::after` goes with the HUD. Keep `practice-thinking` and its `role="status"`. |
| The outcome chip (`practice-outcome`, "DEFEAT") | Yes, but it repeats the board's own | **Merged into the board's result chip**, so there is one outcome on screen, not two. The chip's word stays the board's; a press on the chip (or a button on it, beside `Their hand`) opens `PracticeResult`, and that control takes the `practice-outcome` test id. |
| R2379000's "won't count" notice (`practice-unearned`) | No | The practice setup screen before the game starts if it's known there, otherwise the board's notices (`boardNotices`) as a dismissible toast. Keep the test id, `role="status"` and its wording. |
| The phone's `.game > .turn-banner` | Already shown elsewhere | Hidden on screen on every layout, exactly as the desktop rule already does (`board.css`, the `.game > .turn-banner` block in `@media (min-width: 761px) and (min-height: 501px), …`). It stays in the DOM as the live region screen readers hear. The active seat's glow and End turn's "Enemy turn" already show whose turn it is. |

**The result chip must not cover the controls.** Once the game is over End turn does nothing, so the chip can take End turn's place in the control bar instead of floating over it. Or it sits clear above the bar. Either way, no control in `.control-bar` is under it at any viewport. This applies to the match screen's chip too, since it's the same component.

Then trim the gaps so the opponent's seat starts right under the shell's safe-area padding, without dropping below B29's 44x44 touch sizes or breaking B45 (your hero glowing as a target is never under a lifted hand card). The board's layouts are size containers (`.practice-table > .game > .board { container-type: size }`), so the height won back goes to the cards by itself.

**Out of scope:** the lesson HUD (`tutorial/TutorialHud.tsx`), which shows the lesson's own title and exit, and the coach's docking (R2434003, R0314, R2205000), which is placed relative to it. `TutorialHud` reuses some `practiceTestid`s, so check that lessons still work, but leave their HUD as it is. The online match screen has no HUD; it changes only where it shares the result chip with practice. No engine, view or wire change (CLAUDE.md rule 7), no card data, no fragment.

Read `apps/web/README.md` and the `ui-walkthrough` skill first. Screenshot a practice game at its mulligan, mid-game and at game over (a loss, with the opponent's hand revealed) at 1280x720 and 390x844, before and after.

### Acceptance

- A Cypress component spec (in `e2e/cypress/component/practice-table.cy.tsx`, or `board-layout.cy.tsx` if practice's table is mountable there), at each of board-layout's six `VIEWPORTS` (1280x720, 844x390, 768x1024, 390x844, 1024x768, 390x664), for a practice game **both mid-game and at game over** (a loss, with R2379000's "won't count" state set):
  - no `practice-hud` element is rendered
  - no visible element sits between the top of the shell and the board's top
  - `hero-opponent`'s top is at most 24px below the shell's content top (after safe-area padding)
  - the existing B28 "no overflow", B29 44x44 and B45 checks still pass
- At game over at all six viewports: the outcome word ("Defeat"/"Loss", "Victory"/"Win") appears in exactly one visible element, the result chip. The chip's box overlaps no visible control in `.control-bar` (End turn, the match menu, the gear, the log toggle). From the chip, `Their hand` opens R434's list and `practice-outcome` opens `PracticeResult`.
- Mid-game at 1280x720 and 390x844, with the AI thinking: `practice-thinking` is visible inside `.control-bar`, the turn box or `.board-status` reads the AI as thinking, and `hero-opponent` still carries the thinking ring.
- `practice-new-game` and `practice-menu` sit inside `.control-bar` on desktop and tablet, and inside the open match menu on the phone layouts. Pressing either mid-game opens the same "Leave this game?" confirmation (`practice-leave`); once the game is over, either leaves at once.
- The enemy hero's label names the AI and the difficulty (`AI · Easy`, or the Sandbox wording).
- The `modifier-list` chip and `practice-unearned` render in their new homes and do what they did before (a vitest in `routes/practice.test.tsx` for each).
- `.game > .turn-banner` is in the DOM with `role="status"` and its text, and has no visible box at 390x844.
- The match screen's result chip, with its own actions, still works and also clears the control bar (its existing tests pass).
- A lesson (`routes/practice-tutorial.test.tsx`, and `e2e/cypress/e2e/13-practice-vs-ai.cy.ts` where it covers lessons) still shows `TutorialHud` and plays through.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`, `pnpm --dir e2e test:component` and the practice e2e spec are green. Tests that asserted on the HUD's or the chip's old place change only to the new place, and the pull request lists them.

### Blocked by, part of

Related: #2877 (hero plates keep one size), which also changes `hero-seat`'s surroundings in `game/Hero.tsx`; whichever lands second merges the other.
```
